correctness.rationale: For uniform independent images T:[n]->[n], the components equal the count of directed cycles. Conditioning on each prescribed length-k cycle, k vertices receive one cycle edge and the other n-k outgoing images stay i.i.d.; this yields conditional PGF n(1+k(z-1)/n)(1+(z-1)/n)^(n-k), and the exact finite Q_n sum in RESULT.md. Expanding 1+kw/n-(1+w/n)^k=-C(k,2)w^2/n^2+O(k^3/n^3) and bounding a_{n,k}<exp[-k(k-1)/(2n)] gives uniform compact convergence Q_n->-(1/2)(z-1)^2exp(z-1). Cauchy coefficient extraction yields e^-1(-r^2+3r-1)/(2r!), positive only r=1,2 for fixed r. Separately enumerated ALL n^n self maps for n=2,3,4,5 using undirected component union-find and indegree counts; exact rational coefficients match the derived finite formula; Q(1)=Q'(1)=0.
